description: One compact submerged aquatic plant with five broad rounded wavy leaves, blue-green jade leaves, deep teal shadows and mint rim highlights, short dark roots, asymmetrical low broad silhouette. Isolated side-view 16-bit pixel art environment sprite for a cozy turquoise tiled underwater ruin. Crisp square pixel clusters, three or four shades per color, selective dark teal outline. Small decoration, restrained detail, readable silhouette. Entire plant including roots visible, at least four transparent pixels margin, except hanging anchor. No fish, no bubbles, no water, no scenery, no floor, no tile, no flowers, no gold, no text, no blur, no glow, no background. Single static sprite, not a sprite sheet.
